summary.text: Michael Meredith is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 19 since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a marketing officer at the Bank of Edmonson County and chairs the House Banking and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Michael Meredith lived in Oakland, Kentucky, as of February 2020, and earned a bachelor of science in business administration from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as a loan officer with the Bank of Edmonson County, and he has been a member of the Edmonson County Lions Club.
Meredith took office in the Kentucky House in 2011.

For 2025-2026 he chaired the House Banking and Insurance Committee and was also assigned to the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
